Target Files: frontend/app/page.tsx, frontend/app/recap/[session_id]/page.tsx (new), frontend/app/layout.tsx, frontend/tailwind.config.ts (new), frontend/postcss.config.js (new), frontend/package.json

Polish the frontend for hackathon judges. Replace inline styles with Tailwind CSS, add personality colour themes and icons, show B2 artifact links on the results page, and add a shareable `/recap/{session_id}` page.

---

## 1. Tailwind CSS Setup

Install Tailwind in the Next.js app:

```bash
npm install -D tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer
npx tailwindcss init -p
```

`tailwind.config.ts`:
```ts
import type { Config } from 'tailwindcss'
export default {
  content: ['./app/**/*.{ts,tsx}'],
  theme: { extend: {} },
  plugins: [],
} satisfies Config
```

Add to `frontend/app/globals.css`:
```css
@tailwind base;
@tailwind components;
@tailwind utilities;
```

## 4. Share Page (`frontend/app/recap/[session_id]/page.tsx`) — New File

Route: `/recap/{session_id}`

Fetches session data from `GET /api/v1/recap/{session_id}` (add this backend endpoint — see below). Renders:

- Hero: personality icon + name + tagline, themed colour
- Key stats (income, expenses, savings rate, top category)
- Generated video player (autoplay muted, full-width)
- Achievements list
- "Create your own →" CTA linking back to `/`
- Footer: session ID, generated date, "Powered by Backblaze B2 + Genblaze"

If session not found, show a clean 404 state (not a crash).

---

## 5. Backend: `GET /api/v1/recap/{session_id}` (new endpoint)

Add to `backend/api/v1/recap.py`:

```python
@router.get("/{session_id}")
async def get_recap(session_id: str) -> RecapResponse:
    session = session_store.get_session(session_id)
    if not session or session["status"] != "complete":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Session not found or not complete")
    return RecapResponse(**session["metadata"])
```

`SessionStore` must store the full `RecapResponse` dict in the `metadata` column on completion.
